name: @premiumsarl/babel-design-tokens
description: Single source of truth for Babel's design tokens AND shared API contracts — black core + bronze accent. Generates CSS custom properties (admin + website), JS/TS constants (admin + api) and Dart constants (mobile, via the /dart pub package).

scripts.verify: node build.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && node scripts/check-contracts.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: node build.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && node scripts/check-contracts.mjs
